title: Ardea catalogue file
description: One file per vendor in data/catalog/, loaded into catalog.product by `ardea migrate` (master plan 4.5, 4.11). Comments and trailing commas are allowed; unknown fields are errors.

vendor.description: The vendor's name as it is usually written; default for every product of the file.

key.description: Stable key that components and entries refer to. Never rename: a removed key leaves references without product.

vendor.description: Only when it differs from the file's vendor.

items.description: CPE vendor:product pair as in the formatted string, e.g. microsoft:asp.net_core.
Package URL without version, e.g. pkg:npm/express.

vendor.description: Spelling of the vendor these names belong to; without it the names match any vendor and must be distinctive.

items.description: A spelling, or a pattern with * (any text), {line} (version line) and {platform}.

platform.description: For plugins: key of the platform they run on.

items.description: Container image without registry docker.io, library/, tag or digest, e.g. postgres or mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet.

noisy.description: The vendor ships large releases on a fixed cycle that update by themselves (the browsers): «only important» notices then need active exploitation or an authority warning (ADR 044 decision 3).
